description: For each nationality, count every constructor result record (constructor-race entries). The baseline is the average of these record counts across nationalities.

a.request: For each constructor `nationality`, show the total points from constructor results (ignoring missing points) and the number of constructor result records, i.e. constructor-race entries. Also show how far that number is above or below the average number across all nationalities (unrounded).
a.sql: SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) as total_points, COUNT(*) as num_records, COUNT(*) - AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER() as difference_from_avg FROM constructors c JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.nationality

d.request: For each constructor nationality, sum the points from constructorResults records (excluding nulls), count the constructorResults records per nationality, and report how many records above or below the average constructorResults record count per nationality each nationality has.
d.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) as total_points, COUNT(cr.points) as record_count FROM constructors c JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, record_count, record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () as diff_from_avg FROM stats

b.request: For each constructor nationality, sum the total points from all constructorResults records (excluding nulls), count the total number of constructorResults records per nationality, and report the difference between each nationality's record count and the average record count across all nationalities.
b.sql: WITH nationality_stats AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) as total_points, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM nationality_stats) as difference_from_avg FROM nationality_stats ORDER BY nationality
b.raw: For each constructor nationality, sum the total points from all constructorResults records (excluding nulls), count the total number of constructorResults records per nationality, and report the difference between each nationality's record count and the average record count across all nationalities.

c.request: For each constructor nationality, what are the total points in the constructor results (ignoring missing points)? How many constructor entries does it have in the results, and how far is that above or below the average across nationalities? For each nationality, count every constructor result record (constructor-race entries). The baseline is the average of these record counts across nationalities.
c.sql: SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) as total_points, COUNT(*) as constructor_entry_count, COUNT(*) - AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () as difference_from_average FROM constructors c INNER JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality ORDER BY c.nationality
